title: SearchWiki: Learning to Build and Navigate Knowledge Wikis for Active Information Seeking
abstract: arXiv:2608.29953v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flat retrieval-augmented generation treats a corpus as a bag of chunks, discarding document hierarchy and cross document structure. We introduce SearchWiki, a harness framework that synthesizes a corpus into a hierarchical, typed, navigable wiki and trains an agent, WikiResearcher-9B, to retrieve information through multi-turn tool use. The wiki organizes knowledge into three layers - document overviews, cross- document topic pages, and page-level source records; enabling progressive refinement of retrieval when initial lookup misses. We optimize the agent's navigation policy with on-policy reinforcement learning with a multi-component reward function balancing answer correctness, retrieval quality and trajectory efficiency. translated_title: SearchWiki：学习构建与导航知识Wiki以实现主动信息检索
translated_abstract: 扁平化的检索增强生成（RAG）将语料库视为一堆文本块的集合，丢弃了文档层级结构和跨文档的组织关系。我们提出了SearchWiki，一个框架，它将语料库综合成一个分层的、有类型的、可导航的Wiki，并训练一个智能体WikiResearcher-9B，通过多轮工具调用来检索信息。该Wiki将知识组织为三个层次——文档概览、跨文档主题页面以及页面级源记录；当初始查找未命中时，能够支持检索的渐进式细化。我们采用在线策略强化学习来优化智能体的导航策略，并设计了包含多个组件的奖励函数，以平衡答案正确性、检索质量和轨迹效率。在ViDoRe-V3（8个领域）、FinanceBench以及记忆类基准（LoCoMo、LongMemEval、PersonaMem-v2）上的评估表明，WikiResearcher-9B（即我们基于强化学习微调的Qwen 9B模型）显著优于同规模的未经微调的基线模型。
tldr: 该论文提出SearchWiki框架，将语料库综合为包含文档概览、跨文档主题页和页面级源记录的三层可导航知识Wiki，并通过多组件奖励的在线强化学习训练出WikiResearcher-9B智能体，以多轮工具调用方式实现渐进式检索，在检索与记忆类基准上显著超越同规模基线模型。
en_tdlr: SearchWiki synthesizes a corpus into a hierarchical, navigable three-layer wiki and uses on-policy reinforcement learning with a multi-component reward to train WikiResearcher-9B, an agent that retrieves information through multi-turn navigation, significantly outperforming same-size baselines on retrieval and memory benchmarks.
